# Waqar Ahmed | AI Automation

> AI Automation Expert. Builds 24/7 AI website receptionists (RAG), GoHighLevel (GHL) pipelines, n8n workflows, and Supabase (pgvector) knowledge bases for home remodelers, residential contractors and home-service businesses worldwide, with modular backend architecture for GoHighLevel client sub-accounts. Based in Khairpur District, Sindh, Pakistan. Working remotely with clients worldwide. Make every lead move forward.

Waqar Ahmed's client-facing services are strictly AI agents, GoHighLevel, n8n workflows, and Supabase RAG knowledge bases. The flagship service is the 24/7 AI Website Receptionist: a RAG knowledge base, a website chat widget, GoHighLevel, and n8n lead operations. The AI agent answers strictly from a business's own verified facts, while decisions regarding prices and permits stay with a human. Clients keep 100% ownership of their accounts; he works through role-based team invites and never asks for passwords.

## Who it is for
- Direct clients: Residential remodeling, home-improvement, and service businesses worldwide (kitchen & bath remodels, home extensions, loft conversions, permits, free site visits).
- Agency partners: CRM and marketing agencies seeking clean, modular GoHighLevel Sub-Account + n8n + Supabase pgvector backend builds and technical partnerships.

## About
- Role: AI Automation Expert · Bizko & @opswaqarahmed.
- Background: About eight years in branch banking operations at MCB Bank Limited before specializing in AI automation. MBA (2015), BBA (Honors) (2013).
- Specializing in AI automation since May 2022.
- Training: LOOP Institute of Applied AI, GoHighLevel certification training: completed.
- Stack: GoHighLevel, n8n, AI Agents, Supabase (pgvector), Google Gemini Embeddings.
- Location: Khairpur District, Sindh, Pakistan. Working remotely with clients worldwide; all delivery is remote.
- Handle: @opswaqarahmed

## Productized Packages
- [01: AI Knowledge Base Foundation](https://opswaqarahmed.pages.dev/services/) (n8n + Gemini Embeddings + Supabase pgvector): A one-click RAG library built across 8+ structured business policy sections, so AI assistants answer strictly from verified company facts instead of inventing prices or permit promises.
- [02 · Flagship: 24/7 AI Website Receptionist + GoHighLevel Pipeline](https://opswaqarahmed.pages.dev/services/) (RAG Chat Widget + GoHighLevel + n8n): A 24/7 RAG chat widget that answers after-hours homeowner inquiries strictly from verified company facts, qualifies leads, and syncs contacts, tags, and opportunity stages directly into GoHighLevel.
- [03: Lead Operations, Supplier Quote Automation & Monthly Retainer](https://opswaqarahmed.pages.dev/services/) (GoHighLevel + n8n): Multi-channel lead routing, automated supplier quote matching, weekly executive reporting, and ongoing knowledge-base refreshes.

## Agency Callout
- Available for direct business builds and technical backend partnerships with CRM & marketing agencies (modular GoHighLevel Sub-Account + n8n + Supabase pgvector architecture).

## Demo Builds (Sample Company)
These are demo builds for a sample company (Demo), using test or demo data. They are not paid client work.
- [Website Estimate Assistant / 24/7 AI Website Receptionist](https://opswaqarahmed.pages.dev/projects/website-estimate-assistant/): A RAG agent and chat widget for a sample company website that answers visitor questions from the business's own verified facts, day or night. Offered to clients as the 24/7 AI Website Receptionist.
- [AI Knowledge Base and RAG Loader](https://opswaqarahmed.pages.dev/projects/ai-knowledge-base-rag-loader/): 4-node linear n8n loader (Run to load knowledge base -> Clear old knowledge -> Elite Knowledge Text -> Save to Supabase) with 3 helper nodes (Gemini Embeddings at vector(3072), Default Data Loader, Recursive Character Text Splitter at chunk size 900 / overlap 120), 8 structured policy sections, Row Level Security, and a 1-click deduplicated refresh.
- [Supplier quote automation](https://opswaqarahmed.pages.dev/projects/supplier-quote-requests/): n8n + GoHighLevel supplier matching; one sample run found 4 matching suppliers with 0 send failures; about 17 hours a month saved is an estimate (8 site visits a week), not a measured result.
- [Quote intake and lead scoring](https://opswaqarahmed.pages.dev/projects/quote-intake-followup/): An 8-node n8n workflow scores new GoHighLevel contacts every 10 minutes and routes hot, warm and nurture leads to the right next step.
- [Lead-to-site-visit system](https://opswaqarahmed.pages.dev/projects/lead-to-site-visit/): A Free Estimate Request funnel, two pipelines, a 60-minute site-visit calendar and a four-email follow-up that stops when a visit is booked.
- [Reporting and lead-source attribution](https://opswaqarahmed.pages.dev/projects/reporting-dashboards/): Five UTM contact fields, source-based workflow branching and owner notifications, so every lead shows where it came from.
- [AI customer experiences](https://opswaqarahmed.pages.dev/projects/ai-customer-experiences/): A 24/7 chat and voice qualifier, plus a post-job review system that routes happy and unhappy customers differently.
